summary: Iteration 3: tested user management (/api/users and the /utenti UI), invited-user password setup and email login, the SIMULATED SDI notifications (IN -> RC/MC/NS), the dashboard 'Cruscotto fatture inviate', the Fatturato KPI, and the invoice regression suite. All new features work end to end. Backend: 8/8 new tests pass, and the old suite test_fatturazione_api.py passes 22/22. Frontend: all flows tested pass. Found 2 minor frontend issues and 1 minor backend robustness issue.

minor.issue: The user is inserted before the invite email is sent. If send_email fails (502/503/500), the API returns an error but the user already exists. Retrying then gives 'Esiste già un utente con questa email'. Fix: send first, roll back the insert on failure, or return 200 with a warning.
There is a find-then-insert race. A concurrent duplicate hits the unique index, raises DuplicateKeyError and returns a 500 instead of a 400. Catch DuplicateKeyError.

ui_bugs.issue: The status state is only set from the URL when the page first loads. Steps: on /fatture?status=scartata (opened from a dashboard card), click 'Fatture' in the sidebar. The URL becomes /fatture but the list stays filtered to Scartata. Clicking a filter chip also does not update the URL. Fix: derive status from useSearchParams, or sync it with setSearchParams.

issues: The subtitle says 'Fatture inviate e consegnate', but the totals now also include mancata_consegna.
Only P.IVA is shown ('—' for private clients). The codice fiscale is not shown, so it is hard to see why the invoice is MC.

action_items: Sync the Invoices status filter with the URL search params (sidebar 'Fatture' should reset the filter)
POST /api/users: handle invite email failure without leaving an orphan user, and catch DuplicateKeyError so it returns 400
Update the 'Fatturato mensile' subtitle to include mancata consegna (optional)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 863 lines. Consider splitting it into routers (auth, users, invoices, sdi, dashboard).
The dashboard loads every invoice into memory (to_list(10000)). Use an aggregation pipeline for counts and totals as the data grows.
Users.jsx deletes via window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog. This is inconsistent with the rest of the UI.
